caption: The drawing features three scrimshawed whale teeth, each positioned separately on a plain beige background. The whale teeth are light tan to brownish in color with darker etched designs. The tooth at the upper left depicts an intricate crest or shield flanked by two animals, possibly birds, with decorative elements beneath and around it, and minute text inscribed below the crest. The tooth at the right displays a man and woman facing each other with the man's arm around the woman's shoulders; the woman is wearing a dress with multiple layers, and there is a five-pointed star above them. The tooth at the lower left shows a seated woman wearing a full dress and bonnet, holding a child in her lap. The teeth are illustrated such that the carved designs are clearly visible, and their varying shapes and sizes are apparent against the neutral background.
title: Scrimshaw
